item.title: LETTER: Keep Juneau’s long-term flood solution moving forward
item.description: I want to thank the City and Borough of Juneau for the additional efforts being made this year to support and prepare those of us living in the glacial outburst flood area. Because of the increased communication, planning, and resources, I feel better informed and more prepared for this year’s outburst. After what many of us have experienced, that has made a real difference.
